catalog.name: SPY > 200dma gate
catalog.thesis: Risk-on only when SPY is in a long uptrend.

catalog.name: Calm-vol only
catalog.thesis: Stand down when realized SPY vol is above its year median.

catalog.name: Crash air-pocket cut
catalog.thesis: Cut to 25% risk after SPY −8% in 20d.

catalog.name: Underwater delever
catalog.thesis: Delever the book as its own drawdown deepens.

catalog.name: Vol-target 12%
catalog.thesis: Cap strategy risk at ~12% annualized vol.

catalog.name: Vol-target 10%
catalog.thesis: More conservative ~10% vol targeting.

catalog.name: Dual momentum (abs)
catalog.thesis: Require positive 126d SPY absolute momentum.

catalog.name: Tech RS confirm
catalog.thesis: Full size only when XLK relative strength is healthy.

catalog.name: Defensive blend
catalog.thesis: In SPY drawdowns, blend toward utilities/staples/gold/bonds.

catalog.name: Own-trend persistence
catalog.thesis: Require the strategy equity itself to be rising over 21d.

catalog.name: Market breadth
catalog.thesis: Require enough names beating SPY (opportunity set).

catalog.name: Anti-crowd corr
catalog.thesis: Cut risk when QQQ/IWM become ultra-correlated to SPY.

catalog.name: RSI cool-off
catalog.thesis: Fade exposure when SPY RSI is euphoric.

catalog.name: Gap/shock filter
catalog.thesis: Cut risk after violent 1-day SPY shocks.

catalog.name: −15% circuit breaker
catalog.thesis: Go flat after −15% strategy DD until near recovery.

catalog.name: Half-vol scale
catalog.thesis: Always run around half trailing strategy vol.

catalog.name: Golden-cross stack
catalog.thesis: SPY above 50dma and 50 above 200.

catalog.name: Bond-stress cut
catalog.thesis: Cut equity risk when TLT dumps (liquidity stress).

catalog.name: Dispersion regime
catalog.thesis: Full size when cross-sectional dispersion supports stock picking.

catalog.name: Smoothed trend gate
catalog.thesis: 100dma gate with 5d exposure smoothing.
